recommendation: Keep the source fix. It completes the current-state application of FHIR-25400 in the example surface while preserving the later FHIR-40488 naming; no further core source change is recommended for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-25400 was Published as Persuasive for OO and requested changing DeviceDefinition.version from string to a structured element with type and value details like Device.
initial_application: Commit b1671782cb originally applied the request by changing DeviceDefinition.version to BackboneElement and adding type, component, and value children. The authoritative current definition later remained semantically correct after refactoring, but the active example retained an old complex serialization for the now-primitive business version.
additional_context: FHIR-40488 later renamed the structured device/software version backbone to DeviceDefinition.deviceVersion so DeviceDefinition could use CanonicalResource.version as a business version string. FHIR-40488 and the related FHIR-40503 search-parameter work are already represented on the combined branch, so they were treated as context rather than decided again.
reconciliation: Changed source/devicedefinition/devicedefinition-example.xml from a nested <version><value value="1.0.0"/></version> shape to the primitive <version value="1.0.0"/> shape, leaving the typed device/software version under <deviceVersion>.
source_changes: source/devicedefinition/devicedefinition-example.xml: serialized the current CanonicalResource business version as a primitive XML element and kept the typed device/software version under DeviceDefinition.deviceVersion.

related_jiras.note: Renamed DeviceDefinition.version to DeviceDefinition.deviceVersion when DeviceDefinition adopted CanonicalResource.version; already represented on the combined branch and not decided again.
Later search-parameter work indexes DeviceDefinition.deviceVersion.value and type/value, confirming the current typed version path; already represented on the combined branch.
